effects.name: source-event-chain
effects.source: the source (theirs) Vouch store's verified event chain and the objects it references
effects.capture: on an accepted replay, the source chain's verified head digest, recorded as theirs_head in the MergeRecorded event; a refused merge captures nothing and names the source event and revision only in its output

effects.name: target-store-merge
effects.detail: reads the target's verified chain and snapshot first (its pre-merge head is recorded as ours_head); a merge that writes does so in one atomic commit under the store's write lock, after every refusal check has passed; a refused or no-op merge writes nothing, and a refused merge creates no lock
